nodes.label: ToggleGroup Pattern
nodes.rationale: 2-7 mutually exclusive choices use ToggleGroup with a multiple boolean and an always-array defaultValue/value, not type="single".

nodes.label: shadcn/ui Rules (Project Binding)
nodes.rationale: Condensed project-specific rule set for this repo's base-nova/Base UI configuration so agents don't need to re-derive full rationale from the shadcn skill each time.

nodes.label: Button Spinner (no isPending/isLoading prop)
nodes.rationale: Button has no isPending/isLoading prop; compose Spinner with data-icon="inline-start" plus disabled instead.

nodes.label: FieldGroup + Field Forms Pattern
nodes.rationale: Forms use FieldGroup + Field instead of raw div with space-y-*; validation uses data-invalid on Field plus aria-invalid on the control; disabled uses data-disabled on Field plus disabled on the control.

nodes.label: Chat & Messaging Rules
nodes.rationale: Chat UI composes chat primitives (MessageScroller, Message, Bubble, Attachment, Marker) instead of hand-rolled bubble divs or a raw scroll container; MessageScroller owns scroll behavior including streaming follow and jump-to-latest.

nodes.label: Forms & Inputs Rules
nodes.rationale: Forms use FieldGroup + Field; InputGroup uses InputGroupInput/InputGroupTextarea; option sets of 2-7 use ToggleGroup instead of manually looped Button; validation uses data-invalid + aria-invalid.

nodes.label: Icons Rules
nodes.rationale: Icons in Button use data-icon inline-start/inline-end; no sizing classes on icons inside components; pass icons as component objects, not string lookups.

nodes.label: docs-research Skill
nodes.rationale: Ensures implementation guidance is grounded in official/primary docs with cited constraints rather than guessed, converting findings into a short action checklist and calling out unknowns explicitly.

nodes.label: Intent Workflow
nodes.rationale: intent.md is the canonical, version-controlled proto-spec recording problem, outcome, affected users/systems, constraints, and open questions; committing the reviewed document with Git history forms the audit trail, and the originator/product owner reviews before commit.

nodes.label: old-3 Worktree
nodes.rationale: Superseded by old-4/old-5 for sidebar composition; kept as historical evidence only.

nodes.label: old-4 Worktree
nodes.rationale: Primary sidebar composition/parity contract and custom block editor; an alternative to old-6's Plate v53 editor — one editor choice must be made, not both.

nodes.label: old-6 Worktree
nodes.rationale: Alternative editor (Plate v53, ADR 0012) and local-first Dexie reference; alternative to old-4's custom block editor — one must be chosen, not both.

nodes.label: old-7 Worktree
nodes.rationale: Superseded — historical only, per spec.md §3.1 evidence map.

nodes.label: old-9 Worktree
nodes.rationale: Most complete domain/auth baseline; preferred source for authorization contracts, object revisions, and relations.

nodes.label: SM-2 Spaced Repetition
nodes.rationale: Chosen scheduling algorithm per intent.md/plan.md §3 Phase 3; FSRS (found across old-5/old-8/old-9) is an alternative to evaluate, not a silent replacement.

nodes.label: Auth Boundary Pattern
nodes.rationale: Every server read/write authenticates, then checks Space membership, then acts — resolved cross-cutting finding from spec.md §3.1, evidenced in old-9.

nodes.label: Relations Pattern
nodes.rationale: Edges carry spaceId; both endpoints must match; backlinks filter by active Space — ensures relations never leak across tenant boundaries. Evidenced in old-9, old-5, old-6.

nodes.label: Revisions Pattern
nodes.rationale: Edits create a new revision; publish/archive is a separate explicit transition, so history is preserved and state changes are auditable — evidenced in old-9.

nodes.label: CLI Rules (presets)
nodes.rationale: Never decode preset codes or build preset URLs manually; use the CLI's preset decode/url/open/resolve subcommands and apply/init --preset to apply them.

nodes.label: Updating Components Workflow
nodes.rationale: Use --dry-run and --diff per file to decide overwrite vs preserve-local-changes when updating a component from upstream; never use --overwrite without explicit user approval.

frontmatter.name: shadcn
frontmatter.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".
frontmatter.allowed-tools: Bash(npx shadcn@latest *), Bash(pnpm dlx shadcn@latest *), Bash(bunx --bun shadcn@latest *)

nodes.label: Dialog/Sheet/Drawer Title Requirement
nodes.rationale: Dialog/Sheet/Drawer always render a Title (sr-only if visually hidden) because it is required for accessibility, not optional.

nodes.label: Component Structure Rules
nodes.rationale: Items always live inside their Group; asChild (radix) or render (base) for custom triggers; Dialog/Sheet/Drawer always need a Title; full Card composition; Button has no isPending/isLoading; TabsTrigger must be inside TabsList; Avatar always needs AvatarFallback.

nodes.label: Styling & Tailwind Rules
nodes.rationale: className is for layout not styling; no space-x-*/space-y-*; use size-* for equal dimensions; use truncate shorthand; no manual dark: overrides; use cn() for conditional classes; no manual z-index on overlay components.

nodes.label: Content Validation
nodes.rationale: Validates that documentation references real, non-stale files and flags uncustomized template markers; supports skip_validation_patterns in .ai-proficiency.yaml for known false positives.

nodes.label: AI Maturity Levels (1-8)
nodes.rationale: Aligned with Steve Yegge's 8-stage model; file count matters more than percentage score, and the tool includes hundreds of patterns for comprehensive detection.

nodes.label: Quality Scoring (0-10 indicators)
nodes.rationale: Scores sections, paths, commands, and constraints (0-2 pts each) plus git commit activity (5+ commits for full points), rewarding actively-maintained instruction files.
